packageRules.description: One weekly PR for every minor and patch update, across uv, Docker, compose, GitHub Actions and pre-commit hooks

The Python base image moves with requires-python, black's and pyupgrade's targets; a new minor (3.14 -> 3.15) is a runtime upgrade, not a routine bump, so it waits for approval on the dependency dashboard
A Postgres major cannot read the previous major's data directory; it needs a dump/restore or pg_upgrade, so it is never proposed automatically
